issue.summary: Same supplier on 3 different payment terms across ERPs

plan.diagnosis: Rheinmetall-Werk Pacific Components Pvt Ltd operates across 4 ERP systems (NetSuite, Oracle EBS, SAP_B, SAP_A) with 3 different payment terms (NT30, Net 30, NET 45) creating cash flow unpredictability and administrative friction. With $7,684,050 in trailing 12-month spend, this inconsistency prevents optimal working capital management and exposes the company to duplicate payment risk and supplier relationship confusion.

remedy_steps.step: Conduct payment terms negotiation with Rheinmetall-Werk Pacific Components to establish single standardized term (recommend Net 30) across all entities, documenting agreement in master supplier contract

Update supplier master data in SAP_A and SAP_B to Net 30 (update LFB1 payment terms field ZTERM to '0030'), change Oracle EBS supplier site payment terms to Net 30, and standardize NetSuite vendor record payment terms to Net 30
Execute mass update of existing open purchase orders across all 4 ERPs to reflect Net 30 payment terms for this supplier, coordinate cutover date with AP team
Implement cross-ERP validation rule in Coupa to flag any new PO created for this supplier with non-standard payment terms, require approval workflow override
Establish monthly supplier reconciliation process across all 4 ERPs to verify payment terms consistency and identify any drift, assign to shared services team

plan.expected_impact: Standardizing payment terms will eliminate duplicate payment risk and improve working capital predictability on $7,684,050 annual spend, with estimated 15-day reduction in payment processing time worth approximately $31,850 in operational efficiency (0.5% admin cost savings).
kpis: 100% payment terms compliance across 4 ERPs for Rheinmetall-Werk Pacific Components within 30 days
Zero payment term exceptions on new POs post-implementation
Days Payable Outstanding (DPO) variance reduced to <2 days across all ERPs
Invoice processing cycle time reduced by 15% for this supplier
risks: Supplier may resist standardization and demand early payment terms (Net 15) impacting working capital by $192,101 if 15-day acceleration occurs
Open invoices in flight during transition may be paid under old terms creating reconciliation issues
ERP system data propagation delays could cause AP to pay under old terms post-cutover
Decentralized procurement teams may continue using local payment term agreements bypassing master data
erp_actions: SAP_A: Update LFB1 payment terms field ZTERM to '0030' for supplier Rheinmetall-Werk Pacific Components across all company codes
SAP_B: Update LFB1 payment terms field ZTERM to '0030' for supplier Rheinmetall-Werk Pacific Components across all company codes
Oracle EBS: Navigate to Supplier > Sites, update Payment Terms to 'Net 30' for all active sites of Rheinmetall-Werk Pacific Components
NetSuite: Update vendor record for Rheinmetall-Werk Pacific Components, set Terms field to 'Net 30' standard term
Coupa: Create supplier-specific validation rule in supplier master configuration to enforce Net 30 payment terms, trigger alert on deviation
All ERPs: Execute change-order mass update for open POs with Rheinmetall-Werk Pacific Components to Net 30 terms effective cutover date
